fields.title: Game / stream / channel-rank record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). "top-games" records carry one row per trending game/category. "top-streams"/"game-streams" records carry one row per live stream. "channel-rank" records carry one row per checked channel. Every ranked record carries _approxSort:true -- Twitch's VIEWER_COUNT sort is confirmed NOT strictly monotonic (see CRAWLING_METHOD.md), so rankApprox/globalRankApprox/categoryRankApprox are best-effort positions within a single fetched page, not guaranteed exact platform ranks.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The mode descriptor, game name, or channel login that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (S1-gql, or none on failure).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions (e.g. channel_not_found, game_not_found).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

_approxSort.title: Approximate sort
_approxSort.description: True on every ranked record -- Twitch's own VIEWER_COUNT sort is not strictly monotonic (confirmed live). Treat rank fields as best-effort, not exact.

_truncatedToFirstPage.title: Truncated to first page
_truncatedToFirstPage.description: True if more items exist beyond this page -- Twitch blocks deeper HTTP-only pagination (device-integrity gate).

rankApprox.title: Approximate rank
rankApprox.description: top-games/top-streams/game-streams mode -- position within this fetched page.

viewersCount.title: Viewer count
viewersCount.description: Current viewer count -- game total (top-games) or a single stream's count (top-streams/game-streams/channel-rank).

broadcastersCount.title: Broadcasters count
broadcastersCount.description: top-games mode -- how many channels are currently streaming this game.

channelsCount.title: Channels count
channelsCount.description: top-games mode -- a related but not always identical count to broadcastersCount, both passed through as reported.

gameName.title: Game name
gameName.description: top-streams mode (the game being played) or channel-rank mode.

gameTotalViewersCount.title: Game total viewers
gameTotalViewersCount.description: game-streams mode -- the category's overall current viewer count.

globalRankApprox.title: Global rank (approx)
globalRankApprox.description: channel-rank mode -- position within the platform-wide top-30 live streams, or null if not found there.

globalRankNote.title: Global rank note
globalRankNote.description: channel-rank mode -- human-readable explanation of globalRankApprox.

categoryRankApprox.title: Category rank (approx)
categoryRankApprox.description: channel-rank mode -- position within the top-30 live streams of the channel's current game, or null if not found there.

categoryRankNote.title: Category rank note
categoryRankNote.description: channel-rank mode -- human-readable explanation of categoryRankApprox.

note.title: Note
note.description: channel-rank mode -- present when the channel is offline (ranking only applies to live streams).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across game / stream / channel-rank records.
